blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local car sales sputtered again in August as inclement weather disrupted the recovery seen in June and July, with overall sales falling by nearly 18.1 percent. The Philippines sold 29,611 vehicles in August, down from 36,714 in the same month last year, according to data released Monday by the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc. (Campi) and Truck Manufacturers Association (TMA). READ: Philippine car sales down 2.5% in July “We’re still optimistic that vehicle sales will bounce back over the next few months through year-end.
